impact: `_run_checked` is 72 lines and combines process startup, nonblocking multiplexed capture, output bounding, deadline handling, process-group termination, stream draining, and error translation. I read the full function and grepped all callers; they rely on the same monolithic implementation without lifecycle helpers.
